options.name: Radio & Tea
options.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: cozy Last Light Radio channel profile picture.
Create ONE original square profile image that feels immediately comforting: a quiet personal place to listen to music after dark. Match the supplied banner's midnight navy, honey amber, warm cream and muted wood-brown palette, interpreted with SOFT warm lamplight.
Input image 1: color and atmosphere reference ONLY. Do not reproduce its typography, skyline layout or tuning line as the whole design.
Visual style: charming, carefully art-directed hand-painted lo-fi illustration with a little tasteful retro animation-background character. Rounded solid shapes, warm tactile wood and fabric, soft transitions, restrained fine paper texture. Rich amber interior light against blue nighttime shadow. Human warmth and a lived-in feeling. Quietly beautiful, familiar and inviting, not glossy, luxurious or theatrical.
Composition: requested 1024x1024 square, actual avatar artwork. One strong central motif fills roughly 70 percent of the image; everything essential fits inside a centered circular crop with breathing room. Favor simple clear silhouettes and a few large shapes so the picture stays recognizable at small size. Deep navy opaque background extends edge to edge.
Text: none at all. No names, letters, numbers, initials, frequency labels, logos, watermarks or signatures. No human face, robot, mascot with a radio head, supernatural entity, neon, sparks, headphones, bright halo circle or heavy distressed grunge. One complete image, no variations sheet or mockup. This is a proposed branding concept, not new world canon.
Direction 1 — RADIO & TEA. A small rounded walnut tabletop radio viewed almost from the front at a very slight three-quarter angle, occupying most of the central circle. A wide softly glowing amber tuning window, one large warm cream tuning knob and a simple broad woven speaker grille define it. NO text or numerical scale. It rests on a small warm wooden surface. A single plain ceramic mug of tea nestles beside the radio in the foreground with one gentle curving wisp of steam, secondary to the receiver. A soft off-canvas bedside lamp casts a warm pool of light across the wood and mug. Background only a soft navy evening gradient with a faint suggestion of rain at a window, no detailed room or skyline. Rounded friendly proportions, simple readable shapes, a slow comfortable evening. Soft natural light, not a shining high-tech device or a product advertisement.

Inside, one small shaded table lamp glows beside a compact wooden radio; these are simple bold shapes, not a detailed dollhouse.
